summary: Top-level overview of what RebalanceBAP writes under UserData/BalanceMod and which parts are legacy, generated, editable, or managed.
instructions: Use Runtime for the main generated per-target JSON docs.
Use Library for launcher-facing catalogs and exhaustive option search.
Use Custom for hand-authored custom augments and icons.
Treat the three .cfg files as legacy manual tweak files, not as the complete game export.

sections.label: general.cfg
sections.description: Small global mod toggles such as enabling balance tweaks or hidden augments.
notes: This is intentionally tiny.
It is hand-defined in Core.cs and is not a full game export.

sections.label: augments.cfg
sections.description: Old hand-curated augment tweak file created through MelonPreferences addConfig calls.
notes: Only contains values explicitly registered in Core.cs.
Missing entries usually live in Runtime instead.

sections.label: characters.cfg
sections.description: Old hand-curated character and ability tweak file created through MelonPreferences addConfig calls.
notes: Only contains values explicitly registered in Core.cs.
It is not a complete character export.

sections.label: Runtime
sections.description: Main generated JSON docs for passives, items, characters, managers, and arena settings.
notes: This is the main place to edit shipped game data.
README.md inside Runtime explains quickEdit, simpleSettings, overrides, operations, and advanced fields.

sections.label: Library
sections.description: Launcher-facing metadata and catalogs such as blocks, effects, icons, templates, and AllOptions.
notes: Generated locally for the launcher.
Usually reference-only, not the main hand-edit surface.

sections.label: Custom
sections.description: Custom augments and optional custom PNG icons authored by the user.
notes: Use this when building completely new content.
Custom README explains templatePassiveKey, blocks, overrides, ids, and icon sources.

sections.label: NativeUI
sections.description: Helper files for extra arena settings UI categories and lists.
notes: This does not replace Runtime.
Actual values still live in Runtime and ArenaSettings.

sections.label: ArenaPresets
sections.description: Arena preset files that can be edited, shared, exported, and installed alongside content packs.
notes: These are separate from the single-active content-pack model.
Many named arena presets can coexist.

sections.label: PackDrop
sections.description: Drop .rbpack files here when you want the mod to ingest them on launch.
notes: This is an inbox, not a content authoring folder.

sections.label: InstalledPacks
sections.description: Managed snapshots and active-pack state for the installed content-pack system.
notes: Normally launcher-managed.
One active content pack at a time.

sections.label: ImportReceipts
sections.description: Receipts and backups written when packs are imported or applied.
notes: Useful for rollback or audit, not for normal editing.
